name: Dark Wizard
source:
Step into a world where magic intertwines with daily life, and your peaceful existence is shattered by a devastating attack. The notorious Ravens of Dawn, a terrorist magician organization, has left your family in ruins, taking your parents from you. The enigmatic Lieutenant Liam, a rising star in the magical authorities, vows to bring you answers as he investigates the attack.

But on that fateful night, a shadowy figure targets you. Just when all seems lost, you're rescued by none other than Merlin, the charismatic leader of the Ravens of Dawn. His powerful magic easily deflects your attempts to avenge your family, and the chilling words he speaks hint at a deeper connection: "No, you couldn’t be..." He knows who you are.

How could Merlin—the very man responsible for your family's tragedy—know your name?

Navigate between paths of love, betrayal, and vengeance—the choices you make will shape your destiny.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.darkwizardevil]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
踏入一个魔法与日常生活交织在一起的世界，你平静的生活被毁灭性的攻击所打破。臭名昭著的黎明渡鸦，一个恐怖魔法师组织，让你的家人变成了废墟，夺走了你的父母。神秘的利亚姆中尉是魔法界的一颗冉冉升起的新星，他发誓在调查这起袭击事件时会给你带来答案。

但在那个命运攸关的夜晚，一个影子瞄准了你。就在一切似乎都已失败的时候，你被黎明渡鸦的魅力领袖梅林救了。他强大的魔法很容易阻止你为家人报仇的企图，而他所说的令人毛骨悚然的话语暗示着更深层次的联系：“不，你不可能……”他知道你是谁。

梅林——这个对你家庭悲剧负有责任的人——怎么会知道你的名字？

在爱、背叛和复仇的道路之间穿行——你所做的选择将塑造你的命运。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.darkwizardevil]Google Play[/url]]
